title: HorizonRobotics/HoloMotion
abstract:
HoloMotion: A Foundation Model for Whole-Body Humanoid Control

[ ](https://horizonrobotics.github.io/robot_lab/holomotion/) [ ](https://huggingface.co/collections/HorizonRobotics/holomotion) [ ](https://hub.docker.com/r/horizonrobotics/holomotion/tags) [ ](https://horizonrobotics.feishu.cn/docx/Xs3cdEI8bo1EZuxUfzjckTgKn2c) [ ](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.15336) [ ](https://space.bilibili.com/650643249) # Latest News - [2026.10.22] The [H-bot Competition](https://hbot-competition.horizon.auto/) is now open! Follow our [Track 2 boxing tutorial](holoboxing/README.md) to train a baseline policy in about **21 minutes on a single GPU**. - [2026.10.12] HoloMotion v2.0 brings one policy for sparse-to-whole-body control, with initial 1-point and 5-point real-robot teleoperation demonstrated. - [2026.07.16] HoloMotion v1.4 introduces HoloRetarget at 3,000+ FPS on RTX 4090 for training data generation and 300+ FPS entirely on-robot for teleoperation, plus HoloSMPL for 10+ datasets and devices. - [2026.05.15] HoloMotion v1.3 scales from 60M to 0.4B parameters and 80 to 2000+ hours of motion data, while improving policy inference from ~100 to ~300 FPS. # Why HoloMotion? ## Scales Toward 4-Any Humanoid Control HoloMotion progresses from general motion tracking in v1 to flexible command following in v2, then toward cross-embodiment generalization in v3 and terrain generalization in v4. | Version | Target Capability | Status | Focus | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | **v1** | Any Pose | ✅ Released | Scale motion tracking with large pretrained models, fast inference, and generalization to unseen motions and real robots. | | **v2** | Any Command | 🚀 Preview | Unify sparse-to-whole-body commands in one policy, with an SMPL interface for cross-modal extensions. | | **v3** | Any Embodiment | 🧭 Planned | Generalize motion and command following across humanoids with different morphologies and actuation. | | **v4** | Any Terrain | 🧭 Planned | Adapt whole-body control to uneven and dynamic terrain, maintaining balance and coordinated motion in complex enviro
abstract_zh: HoloMotion 通过参考条件化的 MoE Transformer、大规模运动数据以及优化的训练到部署流程，实现了人形机器人全身控制的可扩展性，在实时推理效率下提供更强的运动跟踪能力。其路线图从运动模仿逐步推进到命令跟随、地形适应和形态迁移，目前 v1.3 版本将参数从 60M 扩展到 0.4B，运动数据从 80 小时增加到 2000 小时以上，策略推理速度从约 100 FPS 提升至约 300 FPS。
tldr_zh: HoloMotion 通过 MoE Transformer 和大规模数据实现人形机器人全身控制的可扩展实时推理。
cover_zh: 人形机器人也能跳街舞？这个模型让全身控制快到飞起｜HoloMotion

judge.reason: 官方发布的人形全身控制基础模型，含MoE Transformer、大规模数据、实时推理，方向吻合且影响力高。
